Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext

Class ExtensionBroker

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.ExtensionBroker
public final class ExtensionBroker extends Object
The runtime that drives BrowserExtension hooks on behalf of FxBrowser. It is the single place that (a) asks the ExtensionRegistry which extensions are enabled, (b) enforces the granted-permission gate per hook, and (c) isolates failures so a throwing extension is logged and skipped without disturbing the browser or the other extensions.

Navigation, popup and page-loaded hooks are called on the JavaFX Application Thread (where FxBrowser lives); lifecycle and toolbar contributions are realised on the EDT by the panel. The broker itself is stateless and thread-agnostic.

    • onNavigate

      public NavigationDecision onNavigate(NavigationRequest request)
      Consults enabled Permission.NAVIGATE extensions about a pending navigation. The first non-ALLOW verdict wins; a throwing extension is treated as ALLOW.
      Parameters:
      request - the navigation about to happen
      Returns:
      the effective decision, never null (ALLOW when nobody objects)

      Returns:

    • notifyPageLoaded

      public void notifyPageLoaded(String url, String title, Consumer<String> scriptRunner)
      Fires BrowserExtension.onPageLoaded(org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.webbrowser.ext.PageContext) for enabled extensions. The script runner is only live for extensions granted Permission.CONTENT_SCRIPT; everyone else gets a silent no-op.
      Parameters:
      url - the committed page URL
      title - the page title
      scriptRunner - runs injected JS against the live engine
